GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 423 (12 Jan 46) ESS/IE
(SCAPIN - 589)
APO 500
12 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Shipment of 1000 Kilograms of Daikon Seed and 1200 Kilograms of Chinese Cabbage Seed
1. It is directed that the necessary action be taken at once to effect the shipment to Korea of 1000 kilograms of Daikon seed and 1200 kilograms of Chinese cabbage seeds.
2. The shipment will be consigned to the Commanding General, United States Forces in Korea.
3. The assembly, packing and shipping arrangements are to be completed at the port of shipment as soon as practicable. This Headquarters is to be advised when all arrangements have been completed.
4. Acknowledgement is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
